data.long_meaning: Derived from the Spanish word ‘hola,’ meaning ‘hello,’ this name represents a joyful spirit, a warm welcome, and a friendly disposition. The name Hola carries the meaning “Joyful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Hola usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Hola belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hola total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
